_source: Rebuilt 2026-09-13 from product/ docs (overview, plans, pricing, subscriptions, faq, instant, terminology). Replaces the Sept-2026 website scrape, which described plans and prices that do not exist in the real product.

_contradictions_flagged.reschedule_count: CONFIRMED by product owner 2026-09-13: 3 reschedules, while more than 2 hours remain. overview.md/plans.md saying 'one' are stale.
_contradictions_flagged.multipack: CONFIRMED by product owner 2026-09-13: the live pack is 4+1 (buy 4, get 5), priced at 4x the Premium tier price. subscriptions.md/plans.md/pricing.md describe a 5+1 pack — treat those as ahead of, or divergent from, what is actually sold.
_contradictions_flagged.reschedule_fee_inr_100: CONFIRMED by product owner 2026-09-13: there is NO 100 rupee reschedule fee. The public website scrape was wrong. Never mention a reschedule fee.
_contradictions_flagged.basic_and_exterior_prices: pricing.md tabulates charged prices for Full Car Spa Premium only. Basic/Exterior tier prices are undocumented, so the bot must not quote them.

business.name: Park+ Car Spa
business.description: A verified cleaner comes to the customer's parked car with their own equipment and cleaning solutions. Not a drive-in centre.

service_areas.coverage_note: Gurgaon only, and only inside the live service polygon. Coverage cannot be checked on this call — always take the address and say the team will confirm serviceability.

packages.name: Full Car Spa Premium
packages.description: The full one: everything in Basic, plus plastic cladding cleaning and polish, and deep interior detailing.

packages.name: Full Car Spa Basic
packages.description: Everything in Exterior Only, plus interior: vacuum, dashboard and interior wipe, seat cleaning, dashboard and interior polish.

packages.name: Exterior Only
packages.description: Outside only: foam wash, tyre cleaning and polish, exterior wax, glass cleaning.

pricing.how_it_works: Price depends on the customer's specific car BRAND and MODEL, which maps to a tier T1-T9. It is NOT priced by hatchback/sedan/SUV.
pricing.caveat: These are Full Car Spa Premium prices only, and are indicative — the app's cart is the source of truth. Basic and Exterior Only prices are NOT documented, so never quote a number for them.

subscription.name: Car Spa Plus multipack
subscription.price_rule: 4 x the Full Car Spa Premium price for the customer's car tier. Roughly 2,000 to 2,500 rupees for a common car — never quote an exact pack price.
subscription.redemption: All 5 can be used on any spa plan and any car tier
subscription.expiry: Unused washes expire with no refund
subscription.limit: Only one active pack at a time

instant_booking.what: Instant (ASAP) booking — cleaner arrives about 45 minutes from now instead of a booked slot
instant_booking.fee_waived_for: customers with an active multipack, or buying a pack in the same order
instant_booking.availability_note: Instant depends on an instant-enabled cleaner being free and is often unavailable. Never promise it — offer it only if the customer asks, and say it needs checking.

slots.note: Slot availability cannot be checked on this call. Take the customer's preference only.

policies.reschedule: Up to 3 times from the app, as long as more than 2 hours remain before the slot starts.
policies.cancellation: There is no self-serve cancellation. Exceptions go through Help and Support and are decided by the Ops Manager — a common accepted case is an address that turns out to be unserviceable.
policies.refund: Refunds are handled manually by the ops team when a cleaning could not be done or a cancellation was approved.

what_customer_must_provide: Water access — about two buckets is the usual guidance
Space around the car to work
The car parked at its final spot, valuables removed
important_service_facts: The cleaner brings all equipment and cleaning solutions
Cleaners will NOT start, drive, or move the vehicle
The customer should be there at the start and the end, and reachable by phone in between
Inspect the car before taking the keys back
not_included: Engine bay or under the bonnet
Seat dry-cleaning or deep fabric stain removal
out_of_scope_topics: other Park+ services not related to car spa
